description: This file defines an interface 'InputMethodSettingsInterface' for adding and configuring input method settings and preferences in the Android input method framework. It contains method signatures related to setting titles and icons for input method configuration UI components.

classes.name: InputMethodSettingsInterface
classes.description: An interface for adding input method related preferences to PreferenceActivity or PreferenceFragment. Provides methods to set titles and icons for input method configuration UI components.

methods.name: setInputMethodSettingsCategoryTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the input method settings category, either by resource ID or CharSequence.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerTitle
methods.description: Sets the title for the subtype enabler preference, either by resource ID or CharSequence.

methods.name: setSubtypeEnablerIcon
methods.description: Sets the icon for the subtype enabler preference, either by resource ID or Drawable.
